content.introduction: The earnings calendar for the week of November 2-7, 2026, includes reports from numerous companies, with Wednesday being the busiest day with 240 of the 755 companies scheduled to report. On Monday, November 2, 58 companies are set to report after the close, including Apple, which accounts for about $5.0 trillion of the $6.3 trillion in total market capitalization of these companies. Specific earnings estimates for individual companies are not provided in the sources.
